name: Solid original
idea: The retained solid-fork direction from study 01.

name: Long tines
idea: Tall tines and a compact curved root.

name: Square bowl
idea: A squared U with soft, generous corners.

name: Open root
idea: The split bowl leaves air above the handle.

name: Round bowl
idea: Two curved shoulders surround an independent stem.

name: Narrow fork
idea: A slender, instrument-like tuning fork.

name: Broad fork
idea: A broad stance with short tines.

name: Dark tines
idea: Strong tines give the silhouette more contrast.

name: Leaning fork
idea: A gentle tilt keeps the fork immediately legible.

name: Deep cup
idea: Long shoulders form a deeper U-shaped cup.

name: Key handle
idea: A wide key-shaped stem beneath two fork tines.

name: Continuous side
idea: One tine joins the handle; the other two pieces float.

name: Three keys original
idea: The retained three-key mark from study 01.

name: Even keys
idea: Equal lower widths with two clear upper notches.

name: Short keys
idea: A compact keyboard with a broad footprint.

name: Long keys
idea: Tall proportions suggest the length of real piano keys.

name: Wide cuts
idea: Larger negative-space cuts emphasize the keyboard.

name: Shallow cuts
idea: Shorter notches leave more of each key intact.

name: Soft keys
idea: More rounding at the ends of the three keys.

name: Pressed middle
idea: The middle key is visibly depressed.

name: Rising chord
idea: A stepped silhouette, still built from piano keys.

name: Dark center
idea: The central key provides the strong-color anchor.

name: Tilted keyboard
idea: A slight tilt introduces movement.

name: Paired cuts
idea: Two upper gaps frame a broad central piano key.

name: Grand original
idea: The retained piano silhouette from study 01.

name: Rounded grand
idea: A smoother shoulder and a rounded front corner.

name: Concert grand
idea: A longer tail above a compact keyboard.

name: Baby grand
idea: A low, wide piano with a compact body.

name: Full shoulder
idea: A generous curved soundboard carries the identity.

name: Deep waist
idea: A pronounced concave waist separates tail and keyboard.

name: Dark soundboard
idea: A strong-color body makes the piano shape dominant.

name: Green soundboard
idea: A medium-green body balances two contrasting keys.

name: Short keyboard
idea: More weight in the body, less in the keys.

name: Deep keyboard
idea: Longer key blocks emphasize the instrument.

name: Slanted grand
idea: A modest rotation adds energy to the piano body.

name: Left shoulder
idea: The piano contour mirrored, with the same color sequence.
